## Task 4 – The menu

**In your IDE workspace**, in the chunks of Task 4 of `index.qmd`. Try the reference specification and three or four others, changing one argument at a time. Then rerun the one that you would defend and send it with `submit_exploration()`. Your mark is drawn on the class chart as an open circle.

[Open the webR workspace at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## The class results and your placement

[Open the class results](../../class-results.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Find your own mark among the exploratory results of the class. Then rerun `try_spec()` in your IDE workspace with the choices that you submitted, or in the cells of [Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){target="_blank"} of the webR workspace, and read your placement, which is the number of the 64 specifications whose gap lies further below zero than yours.

## Task 5 – Preregistration

**In the preregistration block of your report**, the chunk `prereg` of `index.qmd`. Complete the block before you run anything, and render the report. Then fit the specification with `run_spec()` and send it with `report_result()`. Your declared result is drawn on the chart as a filled circle beside the open circles of Task 4.

[Open the webR workspace at Task 5](../../lab.qmd#task-5-preregistration){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If your installation fails, complete the block in the webR workspace, and copy the completed cell into your notes instead of rendering.

## Task 6 – Replication

**In your IDE workspace**, in the chunks of Task 6 of `index.qmd`. Run `replicate_spec(my_spec)`, which translates your declared specification to the new experiment run for the SCORE replicability study and fits it on the data of that experiment, then draw the figure and write your two sentences. The second chart of the [Class results](../../class-results.qmd) page draws the declared specifications of the class on the new data in the same way.

[Open the webR workspace at Task 6](../../lab.qmd#task-6-replication){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
